source_text: Omnis qui tetigerit carnes eius sanctificabitur. Contactus Christi sanctificat; contactus peccati polluit.
pass_a_gloss: Every who will-have-touched flesh its will-be-sanctified. Contact of-Christ sanctifies; contact of-sin pollutes.
pass_b_english: [[Whoever touches its flesh shall be holy >> Bible:Leviticus 6:27]]. Christ’s touch sanctifies; sin’s touch defiles.
